## Confirmed diagnosis

The sole blocker remains unchanged:

```text
696f439: DECISIONS.md §K6/§K9
aeb3c28: crates/sembla-cli/src/main.rs rejection removals
```

This is one commit-atomicity failure. Functional implementation and representative corpus checks remain green; no source revision is justified.

## Required action

Do not launch attempt 5. A no-commit implementation agent cannot repair historical commit packaging.

The operator must:

1. Pause/terminate piprd and ensure `.piprd/run.lock` is inactive.
2. Back up `aeb3c28`.
3. Squash `696f439` and `aeb3c28` into one commit above `2ce6c95`.
4. Preserve this tree exactly:
   ```text
   2c8da8c3bc6fa153727458228e122d3f3285c129
   ```
5. Coordinate any required `git push --force-with-lease`.
6. Resume directly at review.

## Verification

```bash
git show --name-status HEAD -- DECISIONS.md crates/sembla-cli/src/main.rs
git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}
git diff --exit-code aeb3c28 HEAD -- . ':(exclude).piprd/**'
git diff --check 2ce6c95..HEAD
cargo test --locked
scripts/check-rust.sh
python3 scripts/check-markdown-links.py
cargo test --locked -p sembla-cli --features cuda --test gpu_differential
cargo test --locked -p sembla-cuda --test corpus_membership
bash crates/sembla-cuda/scripts/run-differential-corpus.sh --list
```

No code, tests, documentation, corpus behavior, goldens, or hardware-pending outcomes should change. Attempt 5 will otherwise exhaust the run on the identical blocker.
